## History

Julia Bell attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates, participating enthusiastically when their teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), organized a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise funds for a school flag. Later, Julia joined the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as a member. During a society meeting, after [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) revealed that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) intended to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted advertisements, Julia served on a committee of girls who unsuccessfully attempted to persuade him against the plan.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are schoolmates who share a friendly relationship, exchanging small tokens with one another. Alongside other local youth, Julia interacts with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in community efforts, including attending a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where the group attempts to handle issues in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV.
